description: This file contains Python classes for parsing various test logs, including Ptest, LTP, and LTP Compliance logs, with methods to parse logs and output results.

classes.name: PtestParser
classes.description: Parser for test result logs with sections and test outcomes.

classes.name: LtpParser
classes.description: Parser for LTP (Linux Test Project) logs to identify pass, fail, skip results.

classes.name: LtpComplianceParser
classes.description: Parser for LTP compliance logs to identify test execution results.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the respective log file and extracts test results and sections.

methods.name: results_as_files
methods.description: Outputs parsed results into separate files per section.
